body.name: Finite theorem-specific exceptional-polynomial families
body.construction: For each theorem label \(s\), let \(\mathcal Q_s(p,G,G')\) be the finite list of graph-indexed polynomials explicitly named by that theorem. The family \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{term}}\) contains nonzero path minors and augmented affine-support minors. The family \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{branch}}\) contains nonzero rank minors, factor-line discriminants, denominator-cleared chart denominators, support residuals, and the theorem-specific variance-activity factor \(\prod_{k\in V}(t_k-v_k)\). For the fork pair, \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{fork}}\) adds every nonzero \(3\times3\) minor of \(B_{\ell}\), the displayed loading determinants, and maximal Jacobian minors of the denominator-cleared two-scalar systems. Each list is formed after deleting polynomials that vanish identically for the fixed graph pair. Variance neutrality is excluded only from covariance theorem loci, not from the ambient model or terminal theory.
